name: Shad-Rah's lightsaber
description: Shad-Rah's lightsaber was a magenta-bladed lightsaber used by the former Jedi Shad-Rah Varcanella, who served the Galactic Empire under the name Zero. Between 19 BBY and 0 ABY, Zero wielded his lightsaber to duel his former Padawan F aboard the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Oppressor. Using the lightsaber, Zero cut off F's right arm and feet but was frozen by F using a capsule of carbonite.
